description: External licensed mortuary engagement (state-compliance legal requirements only). G5 UPL-EQUIVALENT BOUNDARY: shidemori prepares the data package; external licensed mortuary handles legal-compliance (death certificate filing / cremation permit / interment permit / autopsy coordination if applicable). 4-actor UPL-equivalent pattern (chigiri G14 + iyashi N9 + kokoro G3 + shidemori G5).

publicFundSafeContractCid.description: Public Fund Safe contract CID (Council Lv6+ ≥4/7 authorization; G5 UPL-equivalent boundary — shidemori does NOT engage directly; Public Fund Safe does)

councilAttestations.description: G5 STRUCTURAL: Council Lv6+ ≥4/7 supermajority for engagement budget approval

dataPackagePreparedByShidemoriCid.description: shidemori-prepared data package CID (encrypted per ADR-2605181100; jurisdictional confidentiality)

stateComplianceDocumentCid.description: External mortuary state-compliance document CID. G5 INVARIANT: shidemori does NOT modify this document; shidemori ONLY records the CID.

embalmingChemicalsUsed.description: G7 STRUCTURAL: const false; even external mortuary engagement does NOT use embalming chemicals (Charter Rider §2(d)). If external mortuary requires embalming for transport, engagement is REFUSED.
